title: Romanticism & the Sublime
description: Nature at its most awe-inspiring, and the human drama set against it.

items.title: Statue of the Madonna in the Mountains
items.medium: Brush and black ink and gray wash, with graphite, on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: Caspar David Friedrich's 1804 drawing depicts a solitary statue of the Madonna nestled within a dramatic mountain landscape. Executed in brush and black ink with gray wash, the work evokes a sense of spiritual contemplation amidst nature's grandeur.
items.tags: madonna, mountains, landscape, drawing, ink, spiritual, contemplative, German

items.title: Young Man Lying on a Grave
items.description_narrative: Caspar David Friedrich's woodcut depicts a lone figure reclining upon a grave, starkly rendered against a somber background. The stark lines and strong contrasts of the woodcut medium emphasize the somber mood and the solitary nature of the scene.
items.tags: solitude, melancholy, romanticism, woodcut, print, grave, figure, german art

items.title: Woman with Spider's Web Between Bare Trees
items.description_narrative: Caspar David Friedrich's 1803 woodcut depicts a solitary woman standing amidst bare trees, with a delicate spider's web visible between them. This stark imagery, rendered in a striking printmaking medium, reflects themes of nature and contemplation characteristic of the artist's work.
items.tags: romanticism, woodcut, landscape, solitary figure, nature, german art, contemplation

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: Caspar David Friedrich's 'Self-Portrait' presents the artist's own likeness. Executed as a woodcut on paper, this piece demonstrates the graphic arts medium utilized by the celebrated German Romantic artist.
items.tags: self-portrait, woodcut, print, romanticism, german, caspar david friedrich

items.title: Scene of a Fire
items.description_narrative: This etching by Caspar David Friedrich dramatically depicts a scene of a fire, rendered with intricate detail on paper. Created in 1802, it showcases the artist's early engagement with evocative natural phenomena.
items.tags: fire, landscape, night, romanticism, dramatic, etching, german art

items.title: Girl Standing before a Mirror
items.description_narrative: In Caspar Netscher's 1668 oil on panel, a young girl stands contemplatively before a mirror. This intimate scene captures a moment of domestic reflection, characteristic of the artist's refined style.
items.tags: girl, mirror, domestic scene, Dutch Golden Age, genre painting, realism, intimate

items.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
items.description_narrative: This "Portrait of a Gentleman" was created by Caspar Netscher in 1680, rendered in oil on canvas. The painting exemplifies the refined portraiture popular among aristocratic figures during the late 17th century.
items.tags: portrait, oil painting, dutch golden age, baroque, 17th century, gentleman, caspar netscher

items.title: Infantry Armor and Targe (Shield)
items.description_narrative: This striking ensemble features a complete infantry armor suit, crafted from steel, alongside a matching targe shield. Its intricate design is enhanced by gilding, brass accents, and leather components, reflecting the sophisticated craftsmanship of its period.
items.tags: armor, shield, steel, historical, defensive, renaissance, military equipment, ornate

items.title: Composite Field Armor
items.description_narrative: This robust Composite Field Armor, crafted from steel and leather around 1570, represents a pinnacle of defensive design from its era. Engineered for protection during combat, its components would have offered crucial safeguarding on the battlefield.
items.tags: armor, steel, leather, military, protective gear, 16th century, historical object

items.title: Field Armor
items.description_narrative: This full suit of field armor served as protective wear for a knight or soldier during combat. Crafted from steel and leather, it dates from the early to mid-16th century.
items.tags: armor, steel, leather, military, protective gear, historical, european, renaissance

items.title: Composite Boy's Armor for Foot Tournament at the Barriers
items.description_narrative: This impressive composite boy's armor, fashioned around 1600, was designed for a foot tournament at the barriers. Crafted from steel, brass, and leather, it offered robust protection for a young participant in jousting events.
items.tags: armor, steel, brass, leather, tournament, protective gear, boy, historical

items.title: Three-Quarter Field Armor of Anime Construction
items.agent_name: Workshop of Michel Witz, the Younger
items.description_narrative: Titled 'Three-Quarter Field Armor of Anime Construction,' this formidable steel and leather suit was crafted by the Workshop of Michel Witz, the Younger, around 1560. Designed for battle, it provided essential protection for a combatant in an era of evolving warfare.
items.tags: armor, steel, leather, renaissance, 16th century, military, protective, historical

items.title: Infantry Armor
items.medium: Steel, iron, leather and black paint
items.description_narrative: This armor, crafted from steel, iron, leather, and black paint, provided essential protection for an infantry soldier during the mid-16th century. Its functional design reflects the military needs and technological capabilities of the period.
items.tags: armor, infantry, protection, military, 16th century, european, functional art, renaissance

items.title: Composite Armor for Heavy Cavalry (Cuirassier)
items.description_narrative: This impressive composite armor was designed to protect a cuirassier, a type of heavy cavalry soldier. Constructed from steel, leather, and paint, it provided crucial defense during the tumultuous early 17th century.
items.tags: armor, steel, military, 17th century, weaponry, historical, cuirassier

items.title: Sheet of Sketches
items.medium: Lithograph in black on white wove paper
items.description_narrative: This lithograph by Eugène Delacroix presents a dynamic array of preliminary studies, typical of an artist exploring various forms and compositions. Created in 1826, it offers insight into the artist's working process and his mastery of printmaking.
items.tags: sketches, studies, romanticism, lithography, printmaking, eugene delacroix, expressive

items.title: Study for Marphise and the Mistress of Pinabel
items.medium: Graphite on tan wove paper, tipped onto board
items.description_narrative: This graphite study by Eugène Delacroix, executed on tan wove paper, depicts a scene for 'Marphise and the Mistress of Pinabel'. It serves as a preliminary exploration of the dramatic composition and figures for a larger work.
items.tags: romanticism, drawing, sketch, literary, preparatory, graphite, dramatic

items.title: Lion Hunt
items.description_narrative: Eugène Delacroix's dynamic 'Lion Hunt' depicts a violent struggle between men on horseback and a powerful lion, creating a scene of intense drama and chaos. The canvas is filled with swirling movement and vibrant colors, capturing the ferocity of the encounter.
items.tags: romanticism, animal painting, orientalism, hunting, drama, violence, 19th century

items.title: Arab Horseman Attacked by a Lion
items.description_narrative: This oil on panel painting dramatically captures a fierce battle between an Arab horseman and a powerful lion, showcasing a moment of intense struggle and survival. Eugène Delacroix masterfully depicts the raw power and chaos of the confrontation.
items.tags: horseman, lion, attack, violence, struggle, romanticism, drama, equestrian
